{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40915020/dadbbe3a0e36e659d5172a71a8f686106b4a572d.jpg

[H-Isekai Loves] first game event to thank everyone for waiting patiently for our game



We will choose 3 lucky random numbers corresponding to 3 winning players. 3 selected people will have the right to request the female character to appear in the DLC (downloadable content) of [H-Isekai Loves]. We will create the female character based on your description.

How to join the event :

1- Each of you, enter a dot in this post. 
2- Each person only enter once.
3- You need to own H-Isekai Loves already.

Event Period: February 13 - February 20, 2022 (PST)
The winner will be announced in the comments of this post.

Thanks and wish you have a good day ♥♥♥
